name: United States
description: Follow United States, a tracked place, in Lootura: recent changes, timeline, related context, and source-backed evidence.

changes.title: U.S. Marine veteran, detained in Russia since 2022, is hospitalized in serious condition
changes.summary: Robert Gilman, 32, is being held at a Russian hospital in what his advocate, Eric Lebson of Global Reach, described as a "dissociative stupor.".

changes.title: Morning news brief
changes.summary: Iran says it's close to a deal with Oman over navigation on the Strait of Hormuz, a look at the challenges both candidates for Michigan's U.S. Senate seat will face, Trump touts U.S. economy in Vegas.

changes.title: Iran Hormuz Deal Advances Amid US Munitions Supply Questions
changes.summary: A deal on the Strait of Hormuz could come as early as Thursday, with the Iranian foreign ministry saying a draft agreement between Iran and Oman is under review. It comes as there are new concerns over a potential shortage of U.S. weaponry. NBC’s Keir Simmons reports for TODAY.

changes.title: Iran aims to ban U.S. and Israeli ships from Strait of Hormuz and charge others a toll
changes.summary: Iran's parliament is reviewing a plan to ban ships linked to the U.S., Israel and other "hostile countries" from transiting the Strait of Hormuz. The Trump administration has rejected the plan. (Image credit: AFP via Getty Images).

changes.title: Fled to America at 11. Stole at 18. Deported to Vietnam at 44.
changes.summary: The Trump administration is sending back record numbers of Vietnamese, Laotians and Hmong. Many came to the United States as young war refugees and later committed crimes.

changes.title: Trump denies U.S. running low on some munitions, says vast resupplies being made
changes.summary: President Trump is taking issue with recent reports of significant U.S. munitions shortages due to the war with Iran.

changes.title: Pacific islands alarmed by Trump-backed push for deep-sea mining
changes.summary: A Pacific island leader says there were "no consultations" before the U.S. announced swaths of nearby ocean could be auctioned for deep-sea mining exploration, telling AFP the industry faced strong opposition among his people.

changes.title: FDA Approves the First mRNA Flu Vaccine
changes.summary: —NurPhoto / Contributor—Getty Images On Aug. 5, the U.S. Food and Drug Administration (FDA) approved the first mRNA-based vaccine for influenza. changes.title: FDA approves Moderna's mRNA flu vaccine after initial pushback
changes.summary: The U.S. Food and Drug Administration has approved a new seasonal flu vaccine from Moderna that uses mRNA technology, the drugmaker announced.
